title: Protective Effect of Vitexin Against IL-17-Induced Vascular Endothelial Inflammation Through Keap1/Nrf2-Dependent Signaling Pathway.
authors: Gan, Ting; Xing, Qian; Li, Nan; Deng, Zeyuan; Pan, Changxuan; Liu, Xiaoru; Zheng, Liufeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芹菜素通过Keap1/Nrf2通路抗血管内皮炎症，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: SCOPE: Vitexin, a C-glycosylated flavonoid, is abundant in food sources and has potential health-beneficial properties. However, the targets for its beneficial effects remain largely unknown. This study aims to establish an in vitro cell model of vascular low-grade inflammation and explore the antiinflammatory mechanism of vitexin. METHODS AND RESULTS: Low-dose TNFalpha and IL-17 are combined to establish a cell model of vascular low-grade inflammation. Cell-based studies show that low-dose TNFalpha (1 ng mL(-1)) alone has a slight effect, but its combination with IL-17 can potently induce protein expression of inflammatory cytokines, leading to an inflammatory state. However, the vascular inflammation caused by low-dose TNF plus IL-17 does not lead to oxidative stress, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) does not involved in developing this inflammation. Vitexin can be absorbed by human umbilical vein endothelial (HUVEC) cells to increase the Nrf2 protein level and attenuate inflammation. In addition, the antiinflammatory effect of vitexin is blocked by the knockdown of Nrf2. Further localized surface plasmon resonance, drug affinity responsive target stability, and molecular docking demonstrate that vitexin can directly interact with Keap1 to disrupt Keap1-Nrf2 interaction and thus activate Nrf2. Treatment of mice with a bolus oral gavage of vitexin (100 mg kg(-1) body weight) or a high-fat diet supplemented with vitexin (5 mg kg(-1) body weight per day) for 12 weeks confirms the rapid increase in blood vitexin levels and subsequent incorporation into blood vessels to activate Nrf2 and ameliorate inflammation in vivo. CONCLUSION: The findings provide a reliable cell model of vascular low-grade inflammation and indicate Nrf2 protein as the potential target of vitexin to inhibit vascular inflammation.
abstract_zh: 范围：牡荆素（Vitexin）是一种C-糖基化黄酮类化合物，在食物来源中丰富，并具有潜在的健康有益特性。然而，其有益作用的靶点仍 largely 未知。本研究旨在建立血管低度炎症的体外细胞模型，并探讨牡荆素的抗炎机制。方法与结果：将低剂量TNFα和IL-17联合使用，建立血管低度炎症的细胞模型。基于细胞的研究表明，单独使用低剂量TNFα（1 ng mL(-1)）作用轻微，但其与IL-17联合可强力诱导炎症细胞因子的蛋白表达，导致炎症状态。然而，由低剂量TNF加IL-17引起的血管炎症并未导致氧化应激，且活性氧（ROS）不参与该炎症的发展。牡荆素可被人脐静脉内皮（HUVEC）细胞吸收，增加Nrf2蛋白水平并减轻炎症。此外，牡荆素的抗炎作用在Nrf2敲低后被阻断。进一步的局部表面等离子体共振、药物亲和响应靶标稳定性和分子对接实验表明，牡荆素可直接与Keap1相互作用，破坏Keap1-Nrf2相互作用，从而激活Nrf2。对小鼠进行单次口服灌胃牡荆素（100 mg kg(-1)体重）或补充牡荆素的高脂饮食（5 mg kg(-1)体重每天）12周处理，证实了血液中牡荆素水平的快速升高，并随后整合到血管中，激活Nrf2并改善体内炎症。结论：研究结果提供了可靠的血管低度炎症细胞模型，并表明Nrf2蛋白是牡荆素抑制血管炎症的潜在靶点。
